assets.gate_reason: S10a slime family floor: SLIME_FLOOR (Slime Tunnels, Sludgenest) and Grushnak mushroom creep are native bright-green tiles with no board picture. One opaque light slime-floor master; rules unchanged (harmless walkable floor). No waiver.
assets.scope: Slime Tunnels and Sludgenest SLIME_FLOOR1-5 (and their stairs base); Grushnak Pride UNDERGROUND_CREEP1-5 (as a creep layer over the board stone floor).

references.note: Native slime floor: cave ground glazed with green slime. Keep the slime-glazed-ground identity but make it much paler, muted and calm; not bright green.
Accepted board cave floor master: flat overhead matte finish, scale of grit, low contrast, upper-left light and the calm printed-board surface. Not its ochre palette.

grid_contract.movement: Walkable; no movement rule, no speed bonus or penalty.
grid_contract.danger: None: no on_stand, no damage; must not look like acid, water or a pool.
grid_contract.interaction: None. Sludgenest may turn an adjacent slime wall into this floor (zone on_turn); the display follows via the existing re-tile repair.
grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed floor material; the exporter crops 2 checker parities (parity 1 about 12% darker) and composites it with neighbour edge masks over the board stone floor for Grushnak creep.

prompt_fields.subject: Walkable slime-slicked cave floor seen from straight above: packed pale grey-green stone dust and dried mud glazed by a thin translucent film of old slime, with a few faint glossy smears and tiny flattened droplets; completely flat, calm and even.
prompt_fields.palette: Pale sage and light olive-grey with a soft yellow-green glaze and a few cooler grey-green patches. Light overall: clearly lighter than a dark slime wall and than dark stone brick; muted, never neon or saturated lime; no black.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as flat walkable ground that game pieces stand on: pale and low contrast so characters stay readable; clearly different from a dark glossy slime wall by being much lighter and matte; it must NOT read as a pool, acid, water, hole or hazard: no bubbles, ripples, deep puddles or glowing spots.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead floor material filling the whole square with even density and a non-directional pattern; no border, crack line, step, rock, mushroom, object or shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Walkable floor only; harmless (no damage, no slow). Paint no pool, bubble, drip hole, hazard, stairs, character, symbol or text.

assets.gate_reason: S10a slime family wall: SLIME_WALL (Slime Tunnels, Sludgenest) is a native bright-green wall with no board picture. One opaque dark slime-wall top material; the exporter builds the N/E/S/W masks and the south face. Rules unchanged. No waiver.
assets.scope: Slime Tunnels and Sludgenest SLIME_WALL1-5 (NicerTiles slime_wall layers dropped); nowhere else.

references.note: Native slime wall: a wall of thick translucent green slime. Keep the congealed-slime identity but as a dark, heavy, matte-to-glossy mass seen from above; not bright green, not translucent.
Accepted board wall-top material (TW5 mountain crest): an opaque overhead material of a solid blocking mass, its broad forms, scale and upper-left light. Not its sandstone material or gold palette.

grid_contract.interaction: Diggable into slime floor; Sludgenest may turn it into slime floor with a monster (zone on_turn).
grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed wall-top material; the exporter crops fixed windows per neighbour mask, darkens it into a blocking mass, adds rims/sides and a darker south face toward open ground, 2 parities.

prompt_fields.subject: The top surface of a solid wall of congealed slime seen from straight above: one continuous heavy mass of thick dark green ooze in broad rounded folds and lumps over buried rock, a slightly wet sheen on the rounded lumps; solid and impassable, filling the square.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep bottle green, dark olive and blackish moss green, with small muted yellow-green wet highlights catching upper-left light. Dark overall: clearly much darker than a pale slime-glazed floor or a light stone floor; never neon, never translucent.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as a dark solid blocking mass filling its cell, clearly darker and heavier than any floor; distinct from grey stone brick and brown mushroom thickets by its dark glossy green ooze; broad rounded forms, no small scattered blobs that look like separate objects, no holes showing floor.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead material filling the whole square with even density and broad rounded forms; no border, gap, visible floor, cliff face, drip line, object or cast shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Blocking wall top only. Paint no door, opening, pool, stairs, hazard, character, symbol or text.
